figures.caption: 圖：網路維修中的週六早上
figures.description: 週六早上的客廳，爸爸、媽媽和兩個孩子坐在沙發上，每個人手上的手機或平板都顯示同一則訊息：「網路維修中，預計晚上十點恢復」。爸爸抓著頭，媽媽無奈地笑，哥哥張大嘴巴一臉不敢相信，妹妹則已經把平板放到一旁。客廳桌上放著一盒還沒拆封的桌遊、幾本書和一副撲克牌；窗外陽光很好。

questions.stem: 提示：現代人的生活幾乎離不開網路，不論上課、娛樂或聯絡家人都要用到手機。請根據下圖，寫一篇英文作文，文分兩段。第一段描述圖中一家人面對網路中斷時的情景；第二段想像如果你必須度過一整天沒有網路的日子，你會如何安排這一天，並說明你這樣安排的理由。

1.explanation_zh: 第一段描述圖中的情景；第二段是想像題，要寫「安排」和「理由」兩件事。安排要具體，最好依時間排出幾項活動；理由要說明為什麼這樣安排，例如想離開手機、想陪家人。注意整段是假設情境，動詞用 would。
evidence: 並說明你這樣安排的理由
1.strategy_zh: 先用表示時間的轉承語排出早上、下午、晚上的時間軸，再用列舉的轉承語帶出理由，兩種轉承各管一件事，段落會很清楚。
hints: 第一段：先寫訊息內容，再寫四個人的反應，最後寫桌上的東西
第二段前半：依時間寫三項活動
第二段後半：兩個理由，至少一個用自己平常上網的情形說明

moves.zh: 描述圖中一家人面對網路中斷時的情景
想像如果你必須度過一整天沒有網路的日子，你會如何安排這一天
說明你這樣安排的理由

content.focus_zh: 第一段要寫出網路中斷的訊息與每位家人的反應，並注意桌上的桌遊與書；第二段要有依時間排列的具體安排（至少三項活動），再說明理由，理由最好連到自己平常使用網路的習慣或家人的相處。

bands.descriptor_zh: 回應題目的每一項要求，主旨明確；用具體的事例、細節或親身經驗撐起每個重點。
大致回應題目，但有一項要求寫得單薄，或細節偏籠統、說服力不足。
漏掉題目的主要要求或主旨模糊，多數句子空泛、重複或偏離題目。
空白、離題、只抄題目，或內容少到無法判斷要說什麼。

organization.focus_zh: 第一段先交代情境再逐一寫家人的反應；第二段用時間順序（早上、下午、晚上）排出計畫，再以列舉說明理由，結尾回扣「沒有網路的一天」的意義。

bands.descriptor_zh: 兩段分工清楚，各有主題句；句與句、段與段的銜接自然，轉承語用得恰當，篇幅分配合理。
段落大致分明，但有的地方跳接或重複，轉承語偏少或用得生硬。
重點排列混亂，前後句常接不起來，讀者不容易跟上。
看不出段落與順序，句子彼此無關。

grammar.focus_zh: 描述圖片用現在式或現在進行式；想像的安排用 If I had to …, I would …，整段的 would 要一致，不要混進 will；until 子句要完整。

bands.descriptor_zh: 句子幾乎沒有文法、標點錯誤，能交替使用簡單句、複句與不同的句首。
偶有時態、單複數或標點錯誤，但讀得懂意思；句型變化有限。
錯誤多到常讓人誤解意思，句子結構常不完整。
幾乎沒有正確的句子，無法理解。

vocabulary.focus_zh: 活動與網路相關的字（board game、novel、hike、screen、online、offline、message）要用得準，避免整段只用 play、fun。

bands.descriptor_zh: 用字精準、貼切，搭配自然，少有重複；拼字與大小寫幾乎全對。
字彙範圍偏窄、常重複同幾個字，偶有用字不當或拼錯，但不妨礙理解。
用錯字或拼錯字很多，常讓人看不懂。
幾乎每個字都用錯或拼錯，無法理解。

rubric.deductions_zh: 字數明顯不足（少於 100 個單詞）或沒有分成兩段，各扣總分 1 分；兩種情形同時發生只扣 1 分。離題或空白以 0 分計。

model_texts.label: steady
model_texts.text:
The picture shows a family in their living room on a Saturday morning. The father, the mother, and their two children are sitting on the sofa, and all of their screens show the same message: the internet will not work until ten o’clock at night. The father is scratching his head, and the mother is smiling helplessly. The son looks shocked, while his little sister has already put her tablet aside. A board game, some books, and a deck of cards are lying on the table.
If I had to spend a whole day without the internet, I would plan it carefully. In the morning, I would go hiking with my family on a mountain near my home, because we seldom exercise together. After lunch, I would finally read the novel that has been sitting on my desk for months. Then, in the evening, we would play the board game in the picture. I would choose these activities for two reasons. First, they would give me a break from my phone. For example, last weekend I spent almost six hours watching short videos, and I felt tired and empty afterward. Second, they would let me spend real time with my family instead of sitting together while looking at different screens. In short, a day without the internet would not be a disaster but a chance to enjoy life offline.

paragraphs.function_zh: 描述圖片：網路中斷的訊息、家人各自的反應與桌上的東西
paragraphs.topic_sentence: The picture shows a family in their living room on a Saturday morning.

paragraphs.function_zh: 想像的安排＋理由：依早上、下午、晚上排出三項活動，再用兩個理由（離開手機、陪伴家人）說明
paragraphs.topic_sentence: If I had to spend a whole day without the internet, I would plan it carefully.

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 描述涵蓋訊息、四人反應與桌上物品，安排有三項活動且理由有自己的上網經驗（內容 4）；時間順序與列舉轉承清楚（組織 4）；假設語氣一致、現在完成進行式正確（文法句構 4）；用字正確、以常用字為主（字彙拼字 3）。總分 15，屬穩健版。

model_texts.label: top
model_texts.text:
It is a sunny Saturday morning, but the family in the picture looks as if a storm has hit their living room. Gathered on the sofa, the parents and their two children are staring at the same message on their screens: the network is under repair and will not be restored until 10 p.m. The father scratches his head in disbelief, and the mother lets out a helpless laugh. Their son, mouth wide open, seems unable to imagine a day without his online games, whereas his younger sister has already set her tablet aside. Ironically, the solution is right in front of them. An unopened board game, a pile of books, and a deck of cards sit on the coffee table, all waiting to be noticed, and the bright sunshine outside seems to invite the whole family to go out.
If I had to live without the internet for a whole day, I would treat it as a rare holiday rather than a punishment. I would start by taking my dog for a long walk along the river, noticing details I usually miss while staring at my phone. In the afternoon, I would ride my bike to the public library to borrow a novel my friend has been recommending for months. After dinner, I would gather my family around the board game in the picture, and since no one could check messages, the game would probably last much longer than usual. This plan reflects two needs that the internet often pushes aside. The first is attention. For example, according to my phone’s screen-time report, I spend over five hours online every day, yet I can rarely read ten pages of a book without reaching for my phone. The second is connection. Although my family members are usually in the same room, we are seldom truly together; each of us lives in a separate digital world. A shared game or a slow walk would remind us how much we enjoy one another’s company. Of course, I might miss a few messages from friends. All in all, the inconvenience would be worth it, because sometimes the best way to stay connected is to log off.

paragraphs.function_zh: 描述圖片：用「晴天卻像遇到暴風」的反差開場，寫出訊息、四人反應，並點出桌上的解答
paragraphs.topic_sentence: It is a sunny Saturday morning, but the family in the picture looks as if a storm has hit their living room.

paragraphs.function_zh: 想像的安排＋理由：依早上、下午、晚上安排活動，再用「專注」與「連結」兩個需求說明理由，最後以見解作結
paragraphs.topic_sentence: If I had to live without the internet for a whole day, I would treat it as a rare holiday rather than a punishment.

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 描述生動、有反差，安排具體且有時間順序，理由以「專注」與「連結」兩個層次展開並有自己的數據，結尾有見解（內容 5）；時間順序與列舉清楚、轉承多樣（組織 5）；分詞構句、獨立分詞片語、as if 與讓步子句正確（文法句構 5）；用字精確（disbelief、ironically、inconvenience），以常用字為主（字彙拼字 4）。總分 19，屬頂標版。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段寫出維修訊息、爸爸抓頭、媽媽苦笑、哥哥吃驚、妹妹放下平板與桌上的桌遊、書、撲克牌（沒提窗外陽光，不影響）；第二段依早上、午後、晚上排出爬山、讀小說、玩桌遊三項活動，再列兩個理由並用自己滑短影音六小時的經驗佐證，結尾回扣。would 前後一致、無語言錯誤；句型與字彙正確但較平實。

top.comment_zh: 開頭用 as if a storm has hit 營造反差，Ironically 一句點出桌遊與陽光；第二段把一天當成 rare holiday，三段時間安排具體，再以 attention 與 connection 兩個需求說明理由，螢幕使用時間的數據與家人各自活在 digital world 的觀察都扣回題目，最後讓步再收尾。句型多樣、字彙精準，無語言錯誤。極小瑕疵：A shared game or a slow walk would remind us… 的 walk 前文是自己遛狗，未必和家人一起。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段交代情境並逐一寫出四位家人的反應與桌上的桌遊、書與撲克牌；第二段依早上、下午、晚上排出三項活動（健行、讀小說、玩桌遊），再用兩個理由說明，並以自己看短影片六小時的經驗支持，結尾回扣。時態一致（If I had to …, I would …），無文法或拼字錯誤；句型與字彙正確但不特別豐富。

top.comment_zh: 第一段用 as if a storm has hit 與 Ironically 寫出家人的反應與近在眼前的桌遊、書、撲克牌，也用上窗外陽光；第二段以遛狗、騎車去圖書館、晚上玩桌遊排出一天，再以 attention 與 connection 兩個理由和螢幕使用時間的具體數字說明，最後回扣 log off。句型多樣，用字精準，沒有錯誤。小瑕疵：早上是帶狗散步，結尾卻說 a shared game or a slow walk 讓「我們」更親近，散步並不是全家一起，邏輯略不一致。
